test_title: PYST 35 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 25 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the option that correctly converts this sentence into passive voice:

"Experts advocate for a balanced approach."

options.text: A balanced approach was advocated by experts.
A balanced approach has been advocating by experts.
A balanced approach is advocated for by experts.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Active Voice Structure:** Subject (Experts) + Verb (advocate for) + Object (a balanced approach). The sentence is in the **Simple Present Tense**.
 
• **Passive Voice Rules for Simple Present:** Object + is/am/are + Past Participle (V3) + by + Subject.
